recipes.title: creamy peanut ramen
steps: Mix all sauce ingredients with the ramen seasoning.
Add water to the mix.
Add noodles.

recipes.title: Doll Noodle Mix
steps: Mix the sauce (package seasoning, sweet soy sauce, sesame oil, a little spicy powder) with the cooked doll noodles.

recipes.title: Gyudon
steps: Combine water, dashi, soy sauce, sugar, mirin, ginger and onion; boil 3 min.
Add 300g beef.
Boil 5 min.

recipes.title: Japanese Egg over fried rice
recipes.description: 中華 (Chinese) style sauce + egg (天津飯 / tenshinhan).
steps: Make the omelette: beat 2 eggs with 2 sticks of crab stick and slow cook.
Make the sauce: combine 120 mL water, 1 tsp chicken powder, 2 tsp sugar, 2 tsp Shaoxing wine, 1 1/2 tsp soy sauce, 1/2 tsp vinegar, 1/2 tsp oyster sauce.
Thicken with 2 tsp corn starch (tip: mix with water first before mixing in).
Add 1 tsp sesame oil at the end to mix and add aroma.
Serve the omelette over white or fried rice and pour the sauce over after.

recipes.title: Lou Rou Fan
recipes.description: 滷肉飯 - Taiwanese braised pork rice.
steps: Brown pork belly using saute, 5 min each side, salt when needed.
Add sugar and butter to the saute. Mix well to caramelize.
Add garlic and shallot, fry for 1 min.
Add Shaoxing wine and 1 cup cold water to deglaze.
Add in the rest of the ingredients.
Close lid, 20 min + 10 min natural release.
Remove and thicken the sauce. Mince the meat.

recipes.title: oyako Don
steps: Cut chicken thigh into cubes.
Add dashi stock to pan, heat.
Add soy sauce + mirin; when boiled, simmer on medium.
Simmer 3 min, add chicken, cook 10-12 min.
Add onion.
Beat egg, pour over chicken, cook 1-2 min. Do not overcook.

recipes.title: Pepe Tama pasta
ingredients: 15-20g bacon (or sub Chinese sausage, 1 pc for 2 servings)
A pinch of ishiri (fish sauce), a little less than 1 teaspoon
steps: Mince garlic and bacon.
In a big bowl, whisk the egg.
Mix in bean sauce and soup stock.
Roast garlic and bacon with oil.
Mix all together.
Add fish sauce, pepper, maybe salt (maybe not).
Boil pasta, then add to bowl.
Put bowl on top of pot, heat if needed. Make the sauce less watery.
Add pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Pho Broth
recipes.description: 8 servings. Did not add beef, only bone.
ingredients: 1 cup fish sauce (2/3 if not salty enough)
steps: Boil bone from cold to hot; once boiling, 5 min.
Remove bone, clean pot.
Cut onion + ginger, char until blackened.
New pot, add 5 quart water, add bone, ginger + onion. Add scallion, fish sauce, sugar.
Toast star anise, cinnamon, cardamom, fennel seed, coriander seed.
Add all to pot (can use tea filter bag).
Simmer 5 hrs.
Adjust fish sauce, might need to add 1/2 cup.

recipes.title: Taiwan Beef Noodle
ingredients: 2 spice bags (fennel, ginger, cumin, cinnamon, clove)
steps: Add everything to the pot, 60 min.
